description.en: Agents work with GitHub as the connected person: issues, pull requests, reviews, repositories and Actions runs, through GitHub's remote MCP server. Each member connects with OAuth through a GitHub App (or OAuth App) the org admin registers
description.zh: 智能体以连接者本人的身份使用 GitHub：issue、拉取请求、评审、仓库与 Actions 运行，经 GitHub 的远程 MCP 服务器。每位成员通过组织管理员注册的 GitHub App（或 OAuth App）用 OAuth 连接
